brief.headline: Lead with supply security and a backup supplier — they're in distress (zone = distress, -199.2% profit) and you're 7.21% of their sales, so hold your best price (₹1.62/NOS) but don't squeeze so hard you tip them over.

priceAsk.summary: Hold them to the lowest price we already pay for the same item
priceAsk.target: ₹1.62/NOS for LDPE BOTTLE 5ML WHITE OPAQUE — a saving of ₹3.37 L/year
priceAsk.basis: We pay Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited ₹1.62/NOS today; Berry charges ₹1.69/NOS (4.3% more). They're a pure trader (100.0% traded, 0.0% made), so their price carries a reseller margin — benchmark to a maker's price. The market ask for a 28 mm PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc (typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict MARKET-FAIR), which tells us there's headroom to push closer to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — do NOT offer faster payment

brief.financialLeverage: They are in deep trouble: they lost ₹-22.50 Cr in FY2023-24 (-199.2% profit kept vs 2.3% for similar firms), owe 220.44x their own cash, and scored 1/10 on money-health (zone = distress). Their cash is stuck for 335d vs 70d for peers. But you are a big customer — your ₹81.39 L is 7.21% of their ₹11.29 Cr in sales — so they need to keep you. The catch: push too hard and you risk your supply drying up. Lead with supply-security (qualify a second source now) and hold your best price, but don't demand faster payment or pile on; let them stabilize.
